it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 06/04/2026, em cerimônia da Câmara Municipal, depois que João Rodrigues renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a governador na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 6, 2026, in a City Council ceremony, after Mayor João Rodrigues resigned to run for governor in the 2026 election.
